snippet.title: TooManyCooks!! [Official Trailer]
snippet.description:
TOO MANY COOKS is a local cooperative party game for 3-6 players (iOS, Android) where your team works together run a restaurant kitchen. 

Each player uses their own device to chop, steam and wash their way to victory while sending items back and forth between the team. As a team, they will be shouting orders at one another while trying to figure out the best way to tackle each gauntlet of orders; featuring iconic foods from around the world! 

Play with your friends and family now on iOS and Android!
